decision.reason: [ev-9752cacc0234] is a single changelog line. It says only that Loki configuration defaults were made "better" and links to PR 10793. It does not name any configuration key, give any before or after default value, say which deployments would be exposed, or say what happens to an operator who relies on the old defaults. To write the typed assertion we need the PR or the upgrade guide, listing each changed default with its old and new value.
